claim: L'Air du Temps is a 2-Michelin-star + green-star restaurant in Liernu (Eghezée), Namur province, listed in the 2026 Michelin Guide Belgium.
quote: L'air du temps – Liernu – a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant. Two MICHELIN Stars and a Green Star.

claim: L'Air du Temps has 11 guest rooms on-site at rue de la Croix Monet 2, Eghezée; chef Sang Hoon Degeimbre; 5-hectare gardens.
quote: 11 bedrooms available. Address: Rue de la Croix Monet 2, Éghezée, Belgium. Own vegetable and kitchen garden (12 acres of land).

claim: L'Air du Temps stay packages: Séjour Signature €640/person (excl. Fri/Sat eve) and Séjour Suprématie €730/person; both include 2 menus, aperitifs, 1 night, 2 breakfasts; room upgrades +€20 to +€90; no lift.
quote: Séjour Signature – 640€ (sauf vendredi/samedi soir); Séjour Suprématie – 730€. Moyenne +20€, Supérieure +70€, Suite +90€.

claim: L'Air du Temps SETTING B&B is priced at ~€210 average for a double room with breakfast; ranked #2 of 13 best hotels in Namur district.
quote: Double room with breakfast: approximately €210 average. Ranked as number 2 among 13 best hotels in the Namur district.

claim: L'Air du Temps B&B holds 4.6/5 on Tripadvisor (54 reviews); rooms 4.7, sleep quality 5.0; criticism: no A/C in rooftop rooms, tasting-menu only, no 24h reception.
quote: Rating: 4.6 of 5 stars | 54 Reviews | Ranking: #1 of 3 B&Bs in Eghezee. Rooms 4.7/5, Cleanliness 4.7/5, Sleep Quality 5.0/5.

claim: Les Ruines du Château is at 40 rue du Château, 5310 Eghezée; the property advertises 500m to L'Air du Temps; check-in 17:00, check-out 11:00; free parking.
quote: 40, rue du Château, 5310 Eghezée. This Michelin-starred restaurant is '500 m' away. Check in: 5 pm. Check out: 11 am. Free Parking.

claim: Les Ruines du Château offers 2 suites (La Charmante with outdoor jacuzzi; L'Envoûtante with infrared/steam sauna under the castle tower); both have luxury bedding, Wi-Fi, Netflix TV, mini-fridge; bookable together via underground corridor.
quote: La Charmante: Bathroom (shower + bath), outdoor jacuzzi and garden. L'Envoûtante: Shower room and combined sauna (infra-red and steam) under the castle tower.

claim: Les Ruines du Château: €200 all-inclusive for the jacuzzi room, €170 for the sauna room; won the public's favourite at Horecatel Hospitality Awards 2025 and 'C'est du Belge' favourite in 2024.
quote: Pour une nuit dans la chambre avec jacuzzi, le prix est de 200 euros tout compris, et 170 euros pour la chambre avec sauna.

claim: Independent reviewer corroborates Les Ruines du Château is ~500m from L'Air du Temps; 4.8/5 from 30 reviews; breakfast delivered on wooden boards; evening aperitif service.
quote: The property sits approximately 500 meters from L'Air du Temps... 4.8/5 stars from 30 online reviews.

claim: B&B La Chambre d'à Côté is at Place d'Aische 10/12, 5310 Eghezée (Aische-en-Refail); 2-3 room types (suite, loft, double); free bike rentals; 9.5/10 from 65 reviews.
quote: Place D'aische 10/12, 5310 Eghezee. Free bike rentals are available. Guest Rating: 9.5/10 from 65 reviews.

claim: B&B La Chambre d'à Côté listed on Booking.com from Aische-en-Refail; 9.4 guest rating; breakfast and host highly rated; rooms with private bathroom and garden view.
quote: B&B La Chambre d'à Côté, Aische-en-Refail. Guests rate 9.4. Private bathrooms with walk-in showers, garden views.

claim: B&B La Chambre d'à Côté starts from $151/night with nightly rates ranging $113-$159 by season.
quote: Prices start from $151 per night, with nightly rates ranging from $113 to $159 depending on the season.

claim: Belvicci lists Manoir de Thorembais (5.78 km) and Koru (9.86 km) as nearest non-on-site hotels to L'Air du Temps — both outside walking distance.
quote: Nearby Hotels: MANOIR DE THOREMBAIS (5.78 km); KORU (9.86 km).
